ELECTRICITY — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Electro- Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electro- Magnetism.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electro- Magnetism.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electro- Magnetism.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electro- Magnetism.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands
